use default

same_digits(number: int, base: int) -> bool is
    let first = number % base
    let remaining mut = number / base

    while remaining > 0 do
        if remaining % base != first then
            return false
        fi

        remaining = remaining / base
    od

    true
si

is_brazilian(number: int) -> bool =>
    (2..number - 1) |> any(base => same_digits(number, base))

is_prime(number: int) -> bool =>
    number > 1 /\ ((2..number)
        |> take_while(divisor => divisor * divisor <= number)
        |> all(divisor => number % divisor != 0))

from_one() -> Pipe[int] => stream(1, number => number || number + 1)

show(description: string, candidates: Pipe[int]) is
    write_line("first 20 {description}Brazilian numbers:")

    write_line(candidates
        |> filter(is_brazilian)
        |> take(20)
        |> map(number => "{number}")
        |> join(" "))
si

show("", from_one())
show("odd ", from_one() |> filter(number => number % 2 == 1))
show("prime ", from_one() |> filter(is_prime))
